body: Zack & Wiki: Quest for Barbaros' Treasure is Capcom's Wii adventure about an aspiring pirate and his monkey companion. A talking skull promises them treasure in exchange for recovering the scattered parts of its cursed owner, Captain Barbaros. Each stage places a treasure chest beyond a sequence of obstacles that must be understood and manipulated. Pointing directs Zack through the scene, while the Wii Remote performs the actions required by discovered tools. The adventure combines the observation of a graphic adventure with objects that ask to be used physically.

Ringing Wiki like a bell transforms nearby creatures into useful objects. A centipede can become a saw, creating a practical connection between the inhabitants of a scene and the obstacle blocking progress. Using the resulting item changes the view and asks the player to mimic its operation with the Remote. Sawing, turning and pouring therefore become parts of the solution rather than separate decorative gestures. The challenge is to recognise what the scene contains, understand what it could become and use that transformation at the right point.

Successful actions earn HirameQ points, with the reward affected by the difficulty and the number of attempts needed. Reaching the chest completes a stage after Wiki removes the spirits guarding it, and the resulting grade encourages another attempt with a better understanding of the sequence. The pirate hideout offers access to collected treasures and items that can provide hints or another chance after failure. These systems give the short stages a longer life, allowing an awkward first discovery to become a much more confident performance on a return visit.
